messages:
tori: Hey team — need to push canary 0.9.3 to prod in the 21:00 UTC change window. Getting `deploy:permission_denied` when I run the release job. Anyone able to approve a short-lived prod grant? Also want to pin the release to 0.9.3 to prevent rollforward.

sam: I'm oncall and can approve if security is happy. Is your MFA enrolled and current?

tori: MFA is enrolled but my deployer role seems to have dropped after the service-account rotation. Error: `auth: missing role: prod-deployer`.

michael: We avoid ad-hoc grants for non-release-leads outside the low-risk window, but 21:00 UTC is within our change window. Policy requires two approvers: oncall + release lead. @kate can you sign off?

kate: I can sign off. @sam please approve a JIT grant for 30m. Also recommend adding a release pin: set `RELEASE_PIN=0.9.3` in the deployment manifest so autoscaling/rollouts don't auto-rollforward.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Received JIT request. To request a grant run: `/grant deployer --user=tori --duration=30m --reason="canary 0.9.3" --ticket=<ticket>`

ashley: Ticket INFR-4521 created and linked. Notes: rollback plan -> revert to 0.9.2, disable autoscaler warmup, and temporary traffic hold. Adding rollout playbook link: https://wiki.redwood.io/releases/0.9.x

sam: Approved. @security-bot please confirm MFA token freshness before granting.

security-bot: security-bot: MFA check OK for tori. Last MFA auth: 2024-03-15T16:12:03Z. No policy blocks.

deploy-bot: grant issued: user=tori role=deployer duration=30m approvers=[sam,kate] ticket=INFR-4521. To proceed, run: `deploy start canary 0.9.3`.

tori: Starting canary now. Monitoring traces and token-exchange latency. Will abort if error rate >3% or SLO breaches.

sam: Keep logs in the release thread and post quick status updates. If rollback required, set `RELEASE_PIN=0.9.2` and run `deploy rollback 0.9.2`.

ashley: I'll push the short release note: "0.9.3 canary: feature X enabled. Monitor for increased tail latency; revert to 0.9.2 if >3% errors."
